name: Interloper
source:
The Interloper is the game's central protagonist, a Mindspike contractor hired by the FBX, and the lens through which the game is played. Making use of their intraspinal Mindspike implant, the Interloper is able to tap into residual memory data and navigate thoughtspaces contained within the corrucyst. They also inherit and bear masks from the cyst, which reside within their mind to be used on anything.

The Interloper's main mission in connecting to the cyst is to learn what happened to Akizet, with the additional goal after meeting Velzie of restoring communications and connecting to the Network. They are aided by Moth, who supplies them with the technical support necessary for connection, as well as outside information about a variety of subjects related to their mission. 

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Interloper]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
